# Reploy controlled-session v1 fixtures

These files are exact copies of Reploy's public controlled-session fixtures at
version `0.7.0.dev1`, commit
`cb4ed96519b97ecdee6dca28edc78a74c045f7c2`.

Source directory:
`https://github.com/omry/reploy/tree/cb4ed96519b97ecdee6dca28edc78a74c045f7c2/testdata/controlled-session`

`manifest.json` records SHA-256 digests so updates remain explicit. The
controller stream and host-result fixtures are codec conformance inputs. The
OmegaFlow fixture is retained for the later real controlled-session integration
proof; it is not itself a controller-stream message.
